question: Which TikTok star showed up to her own divorce in a custom shirt?
story: One of TikTok's biggest makeup stars showed up to her own divorce wearing a shirt that said Just Divorced. Mikayla Nogueira, the beauty reviewer with millions of followers, finalized her divorce from Cody Hawken on July twenty eighth. Instead of a quiet statement, she posted a video of herself standing on the courthouse steps in that shirt, crying happy tears. Her caption read, the tears I shed, and said words could not explain how happy she was. According to People, the two were married more than two years, and she first announced the split back in February. Her followers watched that entire relationship play out on their phones. The wedding, the videos, all of it. Which is exactly why a courthouse celebration video hit so hard. Some people end a marriage quietly. She ended hers with a custom shirt and a camera. Honestly, that is the most TikTok exit of all time.
